budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Fulfil three distinct private workshop orders using conserved raw stock, shared heat, cooling, a press and one transport/handling tool.
task.natural_termination: All three order-completed flags true. Otherwise H=144 truncates; shortage is not automatically declared impossible.
task.interaction: Any worker can spend or vent common heat, reserve shared machines/tongs, consume coolant, deliver or supply components, and change another worker future recipe timing. Transfers and two-piece assembly depend on partner positioning and waiting. Personal completion plus shared bonuses creates mixed incentives.
task.observation_access: All physical positions, materials, machines, resources, ownership, thermal state and displayed events are public. Only each role own order_kind is returned as a private one-hot; other order values are omitted from both role observations and scene attributes. Public behavior may legitimately reveal information about an order.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Current shared kiln heat; not a per-step event
Remaining shared fuel; not a per-step event
Current shared cooling reservoir; not a per-step event
Fuel was consumed or an adjacent vent was commanded this transition
A hot carried workpiece was quenched this transition
Two annealed one-unit workpieces were committed to the shared press this transition
A worker delivered the exact product required by its own order this transition

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
